title: Why Is It Hate Speech? Masked Rationale Prediction for Explainable Hate Speech Detection
findings: The proposed models, BERT-MRP and BERT-RP, demonstrated improved performance in bias metrics across all ten target social groups, including the religious groups 'Islam' and 'Jewish'. The paper states these models scored 'evenly high for all the target groups', indicating reduced and more consistent bias compared to baseline models like BERT and BERT-HateXplain.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the model's bias in hate speech detection against various target social groups, including the religious groups 'Islam' and 'Jewish'. This was evaluated using bias metrics such as Subgroup AUC, BPSN (Background Positive, Subgroup Negative), and BNSP (Background Negative, Subgroup Positive).
